title: Gemma 4 runs locally with tool calls
note: Gemma 4 E2B and E4B on the Mac via Ollama and Google's LiteRT-LM. Given a camera image and six robot tools, every call returned a well-formed tool call. LiteRT-LM also took a spoken command directly as audio: 'turn left' became turn(90).
say: The robot's brain is Gemma 4, running entirely on this laptop, no cloud.
